conceptual_change: Introduce a mean-reversion filter utilizing the zscore of price relative to a 50-period rolling mean to identify oversold conditions for mean-reverting entry triggers.
rationale: The original PCA/OU strategy relies on residual stationarity. By approximating this with a zscore of the close price, we isolate short-term deviations from the long-term trend, facilitating mean-reversion signals consistent with statistical arbitrage principles.
